metaDescription: AYAS teachers and team: each specialist's experience, specialization, biography, and the classes they lead.

hero.title: Teachers
hero.lead: Meet the school's teachers and team. Read each specialist's experience, specialization, biography, and the classes they lead.

empty: No one matches this specialization. Choose another one.

people.name: Anahit Grigoryan
people.experience: Twenty years of stage performance and studio teaching.
people.biography: Anahit leads the classical program. She shapes barre, center work, and the rehearsals that carry a class to the stage.

people.name: Mane Avagyan
people.biography: Mane works with floor work, improvisation, and a personal movement language for teens and adults.

people.name: Tigran Hakobyan
people.experience: Fifteen years with Armenian dance ensembles.
people.biography: Tigran teaches traditional dance as ensemble work, from a child's first pattern to stage repertoire.

people.name: Lilit Sargsyan
people.experience: Nine years with beginners and adults returning to dance.
people.biography: Lilit keeps a first visit simple and builds adult ballet at a pace that respects the body's experience.

people.name: Nune Petrosyan
people.experience: Eight years coordinating programs, visits, and the studio day.
people.biography: Nune is part of the school team. She welcomes new students, explains the groups, and keeps the daily schedule in order.
